run_self_attention_training: run the self-attention model training loop with hierarchical tree-generated synthetic datasets
create_sablock: create a self-attention block with optional Wk/Wq projections, FFN, and residual connections
create_model: create a multi-layer self-attention model with embedding and classification head for sequence data
create_tree_node: create a TreeNode with probabilities and subtrees for hierarchical data generation
create_hiergenerator: create a HierGenerator that samples token sequences from a hierarchical probability tree
